notes.title: 2025.08.30 Minor Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694724/82ad49c561ce330fe250c1957ee4e8318e83b9ab.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Greetings, Saint Candidates! 👋[/b][/p][p]
Hello everyone, and thank you for playing [i]Berserker Girl[/i]!  
This minor update focuses on polishing the combat system to make battles feel smoother and more comfortable.
[/p][h3][b]1. Dodge Invincibility Fix[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Previously, even during the 0.5-second invincibility window, taking a hit could trigger a hit reaction and cancel your dodge.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when you are in the invincible state, your dodge animation will continue smoothly without being interrupted by enemy attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]This makes dodging more consistent and gives you full control over invincibility frames.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]2. Combo & Stamina Flow[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Previously, if you ran out of stamina mid-combat, your combo chain would immediately reset, disrupting the flow of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, even if stamina is temporarily depleted, your combo window will stay active. Once stamina regenerates, you can continue your combo seamlessly.[/p][/*][*][p]This creates a smoother and more flexible combat experience, especially during intense fights.[/p][/*][/list][p]
I hope these adjustments help you enjoy a more fluid and satisfying gameplay experience.  
As always, thank you for your support, and stay tuned for more updates! 🎮
[/p]
